_comment: Single source of truth for version pins, ports, paths, and defaults shared across the npm and Docker install paths. Read by scripts/dev-safe.mjs, scripts/dev-with-automation.mjs, docker/entrypoint.sh (via generated defaults.env), and .github/workflows/docker.yml.

python._comment: Interpreter request the npm and desktop launchers pass to uvx as --python for agent-server and automation. Without it uvx downloads the newest CPython when it finds no suitable interpreter, which breaks every autumn until the SDK's compiled dependencies (lmnr-claude-code-proxy, fastuuid) publish wheels for the new release (OpenHands/OpenHands#18654). Raise the upper bound once they do. UV_PYTHON in the environment replaces it.

ports._vscodeComment: Port the bundled editor binds to inside the container; agent-server's own default. Only the Docker entrypoint reads this — the npm launchers derive the editor port from the agent-server port so several stacks can run side by side. It is never published: the editor is reached through paths.vscodeBasePath on the proxy port.

paths._vscodeBasePathComment: Path prefix the bundled editor is served under, on the same origin as the canvas. Passed to agent-server as OH_VSCODE_BASE_PATH (it launches openvscode-server with --server-base-path and advertises the prefix in /api/vscode/url), and registered as an ingress route to the VSCode port. Keeping one value on both sides is what lets a single-origin deployment reach the editor without publishing a second port. Tradeoff: a path prefix routes but does not isolate, so the editor shares the canvas's browser origin and therefore its localStorage — see docs/SELF_HOSTING.md and OpenHands/OpenHands#16492.

mars._comment: DigitalOcean Managed Agents: the Electron desktop app and the web build (its server hosts the experimental bridge only with MARS_WEB=1). apiBaseUrl is the harness API both use. oauthClientId (desktop only; the web build offers personal access tokens only) is the public client ID of the DigitalOcean OAuth app registered with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:53682/callback; implicit grant needs no secret. Leave empty to offer personal access tokens only. Overridden at runtime by DO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / MARS_API_BASE_URL. Read by scripts/mars-tunnel-bridge.mjs.
